issue.title: Stabilize snippet-name elsewhere-collision verdict under full-suite load
issue.description: Phase sase-rd.5 observed tests/ace/tui/modals/test_snippet_name_modal.py::test_elsewhere_collision_loads_other_template_but_keeps_destination leave the verdict at Checking after a fixed 0.25s pause under full-suite contention; an immediate serial rerun passed. Replace the fixed pause with an explicit wait_for on the collision verdict.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed once under the full parallel suite with the verdict still on Checking after 0.25s; immediate serial rerun on the unchanged tree passed. Fail/pass observation 1/2; does not reproduce serially.
